title: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2608.28926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.

translated_title: 利用轮次转换动态进行多方对话中的意图识别
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于多方对话意图识别的多任务学习方法，该方法利用了一个建模轮次转换动态的辅助任务。具体而言，我们引入了轮次转换熵，这是一种从说话人转换序列中计算得到的自监督目标，用于量化交互模式的可预测性。在多个预训练模型上的实验表明，加入这一辅助任务可以提高意图识别性能，优于忽略多方交互动态的现有方法。我们还发现，所提出的连续目标可以作为单任务目标进行学习，这表明它是一个确实携带有用信息的真实信号。
tldr: 提出将轮次转换熵作为辅助任务的多任务学习方法，通过建模多方对话中的轮次转换动态来显著提升意图识别性能。
en_tdlr: A multi-task learning approach that introduces turn-transition entropy as an auxiliary task to model turn-taking dynamics, improving intent recognition performance in multi-party conversations.
